description: Produce a Gate A-ready system design for the current Change Brief without implementing it.
agent: system-designer
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, the current Change Brief/DoD, Stage 0 packet, and authoritative evidence.

Define scope/non-goals, actors/boundaries, responsibilities, contracts, invariants, state/data/control flows, failure/recovery semantics, security/reliability/observability, compatibility constraints, alternatives, unknowns, and requirement traceability.

Use Mermaid where it improves verification. Stop before implementation details that belong to Gate B. Finish with Gate A readiness and hand to a fresh Design Critic.
